notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content: The No Rest for the Weary demo is out now! The demo contains the first school week, have fun!

notes.title: Welcome to No Rest for the Weary!
notes.content:
I'm making No Rest for the Weary! I've had a lot of fun developing this game and I want to communicate more with all of my billions and billions of loyal fans. 

For the release date, I don't know when this game will fully release but it won't be anytime soon. However, the demo should (hopefully) release in 2-3 months! If you want to see more of the game, you can checkout the game's bluesky page, the link is in the Steam page.

What is something that YOU want to see from the game? Please let me know!

Tumble Arts.
